subject: Vote-By-Mail Tutorial for 2020 Primary
overview: The meeting provided a step-by-step tutorial on the vote-by-mail process for the upcoming September 1st primary election. The presentation highlighted critical deadlines for registration and ballot submission to ensure all votes are counted despite potential postal delays.

items.title: Tutorial Overview and Deadlines
items.summary: Spencer presented an overview of the vote-by-mail process, urging residents to submit applications and ballots early to avoid election office backlogs.

items.title: Step 1: Voter Registration
items.summary: The presenter explained that residents must register or verify their registration and party affiliation by August 22nd.

items.title: Step 2: Ballot Application
items.summary: Detailed instructions were provided for completing the application, including the requirement for independent voters to select a party and the necessity of electronic or physical signatures.

items.title: Tracking Applications
items.summary: Speakers recommended using the state website to track application status and contacting local election offices in Medford or Somerville if issues arise.

items.title: Step 3: Ballot Submission
items.summary: The meeting covered instructions for completing the official ballot and recommended a return deadline of August 18th to account for USPS delays.

items.title: Questions and Answers
items.summary: Discussion clarified that ballots include prepaid postage and outlined the procedure for requesting a replacement if a voter makes a mistake on their ballot.
